messages:
Olivia Park: Quick share — ran the reranker + embedding throughput sweep across GPUs and regions this morning. Put full CSV and charts on the shared drive: https://redwood-internal/shares/bench/1755032100/embed-rerank-2025.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Olivia Park: TL;DR: H100 >> A10G >> T4 for raw GPU throughput; CPU (8c) only viable for tiny dim/batch cases. Quantized int8 gives ~1.5-1.8x throughput on A10G for 1536-d embeddings with modest quality delta. Region differences ~10-25% depending on kernel+driver combos.

Samir Patel: Nice — can you paste the commands you used? curious about exact batch sizes and warmup behavior.

Olivia Park: Sure, used the bench harness (same we used for LLM bring-up). Example command:

```bash
python infra/bench/bench_embeddings.py \
  --model embed-base-1536 \
  --dim 1536 \
  --batch 64 \
  --backend gpu \
  --gpu A10G \
  --region us-west1 \
  --warmup 30 \
  --iters 200
```

Olivia Park: For reranker (cross-encoder) we did pairwise batching with seq_len=256 and batch sizes of 1,4,8. All runs pinned to isolated capacity (no noisy-neighbor runs) except the eu-west1 T4 baseline which was a shared infra run to reflect prod-like noise.

benchmark-bot: Automated results upload: /bench/results/1755032100/embed-rerank-2025.csv (sha256: a3f1...e9). Summary lines:
- embed dim=512: H100@64=9800 vec/s (p99=22ms), A10G@64=4200 vec/s (p99=35ms), CPU8@64=460 vec/s (p99=180ms)
- embed dim=1536: H100@64=3800 vec/s (p99=40ms), A10G@64=1600 vec/s (p99=65ms), CPU8@64=140 vec/s (p99=420ms)
- embed dim=3072: H100@32=900 vec/s (p99=85ms), A10G@32=420 vec/s (p99=140ms)
- reranker seq256 (cross-encoder): H100@8=420 req/s (p99=60ms), A10G@8=180 req/s (p99=120ms), T4@8=120 req/s (p99=160ms)

Leah Gomez: That H100/A10G gap is larger than I expected for embeddings. Do you have kernel choices noted? cudnn/cublas versions?

Olivia Park: Yep — kernel selection mattered a lot. Notes from the run:
- us-east1 (H100) was using cuda 12.2 + cuBLAS optimized kernels, compiled with our fused-attn2 path. Best perf for dims >=1536.
- us-west1 (A10G) used cuda 11.8 flavors with a different GEMM scheduling; good single-GPU throughput but 30-40% slower for long dims compared to H100.
- eu-west1 (T4) hit old kernels (cuda 11.2) and had no fused path for some ops, hence ~20-30% lower throughput.

Olivia Park: Also ran an int8 quant experiment for embed-base-1536 on A10G: baseline 1600 vec/s -> quantized 2600 vec/s (batch64), p99 went from 65ms -> 48ms. Quality check (cosine sim on eval set of 2k pairs): avg delta in cosine ~0.008, recall@10 drop 0.6 points.

Samir Patel: Good tradeoff for cost-sensitive customers. Any memory/latency surprises?

Olivia Park: Memory headroom on A10G allowed larger effective batch; on H100 we could push batch128 for dim512 and see diminishing returns beyond 128. Reranker latency is more sensitive to seq_len; padding inefficiencies killed throughput for variable-length lists — use bucketing.

Leah Gomez: Region effect — is that consistent across instance sizes or noisy? I ask because sales asked about predictable SLAs in eu vs us.

Olivia Park: eu-west1 was consistently lower in our three runs (10-25%). Cause: older kernel + slightly noisier multiplexing on T4 machines. We also ran a controlled isolated T4 instance and saw throughput ~10% better than the noisy baseline but still ~15% behind A10G. Recommendation: for SLA-critical embeddings/rerank, reserve capacity (Dedicated) in region or prefer H100 in us-east for heavy workloads.

benchmark-bot: Perf notes attached in CSV: columns: run_ts, region, gpu_type, model, dim, batch, vectors_per_sec, p50_ms, p99_ms, quantized(true/false), notes

Samir Patel: Thanks — can you add a small chart to the dashboard showing throughput vs batch for dim 1536 across GPUs? Sounds like a convincing sales artifact.

Olivia Park: Will do. Planning to add two dashboards: 1) vectors/sec vs batch by GPU & region, 2) reranker req/s vs batch + p99. I'll ping when the Grafana panels are live. :mag_right:

Leah Gomez: One more ask — can we get model-quality pairing for the int8 runs included so product teams can eyeball regressions? Even a small set of queries with before/after embeddings would help.

Olivia Park: Yep — adding a quality diff CSV and a tiny eval notebook to the share. Linking when uploaded.

infra-bot: Deploy job 1755032150 completed: created isolated A10G test fleet for runs — ID fleet-ao7.

Olivia Park: Thanks all — will follow up with dashboard link and the eval notebook later today. :white_check_mark:
